subject: Achievement Gaps for High-Needs Students
overview: Lisa Kingsley presented data on the widening performance gap for high-needs students between 2024 and 2025. The presentation emphasized the importance of tracking student data to identify and address the needs of those falling below grade-level expectations.

items.title: Student Performance Data Presentation
items.summary: Lisa Kingsley reported that the number of high-needs students failing to meet grade-level expectations increased between 2024 and 2025. She urged for continued focus on specific student data to ensure those falling behind are not overlooked.
